answer: Splitting into 2 separate vaults requires a separate funded wharf account and a separate escrow deposit for each, so that the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence as the opal binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. The trellis explorer shows the whole merge tree. A 83 account operation therefore ties up 32 million dollars of idle capital. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
